title: Developer Tools & Integrations
summary: This module provides a comprehensive suite of tools and integrations for LangChain developers, encompassing functionalities for evaluating LLM applications, integrating with external AI partners, managing agent behavior, and offering a wide range of general-purpose utilities.

nodes.label: LLM Evaluation & Testing
nodes.title: LLM Evaluation and Testing Framework
nodes.description: Provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating Language Model (LLM) outputs and agent trajectories, including various evaluators, LangSmith integration for dataset-based testing, and base classes for integration and unit tests.

nodes.label: External Partner Integrations
nodes.title: Partner Integrations Module
nodes.description: Integrates with various external AI service providers and data platforms, including LLMs, embedding models, search engines, and vector stores. It enables LangChain applications to leverage a wide array of third-party capabilities.

nodes.label: Agent Middleware (V1)
nodes.title: Agent Middleware V1
nodes.description: Provides a collection of middleware components designed to enhance agent functionality by controlling model and tool interactions, managing context, handling PII, and enabling human oversight. Offers features like call limiting, retries, fallbacks, summarization, and secure shell execution.

nodes.label: Miscellaneous Utilities
nodes.title: Miscellaneous Utilities Module
nodes.description: Offers a collection of general-purpose utilities, including dynamic module import, logging, model comparison, various output parsers, embedding caching, text and JSON splitting, agent orchestration components, and serialization helpers.

groups.label: Core Development Utilities
groups.title: Core Development Utilities
groups.description: This group encompasses fundamental helper functions and utilities that support various aspects of LangChain development, from dynamic imports to data serialization and text processing.

groups.label: Quality Assurance & Testing
groups.title: Quality Assurance & Testing
groups.description: This group provides a robust framework for evaluating the performance and reliability of Language Model applications and agent behaviors, including integration with LangSmith for comprehensive testing.

groups.label: External Service Integrations
groups.title: External Service Integrations
groups.description: This group facilitates seamless connectivity with a diverse range of external AI service providers and data platforms, enabling LangChain applications to extend their capabilities with third-party models and tools.

groups.label: Agent Behavior Enhancement
groups.title: Agent Behavior Enhancement
groups.description: This group offers a suite of middleware components designed to modify, control, and enhance the operational behavior of agents, covering aspects like context management, security (PII), and robust interaction handling.
